question: Do the Account Info and Contact Info steps of the Market Data free sign-up ask for a phone number, an address or employer details, and can a Free Forever account be opened without starting the 30-day trial?
why: Only the plan-selection step (Starter Trial or Trader Trial, both labelled no credit card required) is shown before submission, and the page says the trial moves to Free Forever after 30 days.
